summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of FREA! game. Tested lobby, Character Studio, all 7 arcade modes with themed arenas, Zen Sandbox features including world switching and magic effects, Flea House, and mobile layout. All major features are working correctly with beautiful visuals and smooth interactions. Only one minor UI issue found with Character Studio close button.

ui_bugs.issue: Studio modal doesn't close properly when clicking close button - remains visible after close

design_issues.issue: Potential overlap between Zen dock and emote FAB on mobile viewport (390x844). Dock at y=526, FAB at y=780 - FAB appears below dock which may cause overlap
